name: ShellSafetyChecker
description: Run the shell safety checker (missing set -euo pipefail, background job silent failure risk, hardcoded credentials) against shell scripts. Returns findings.

target.description: Target directory or file to scan (default: cwd)

prompt.mandatory_instruction: Run ShellSafetyChecker on shell scripts in the workspace to validate strict mode, silent failure risks, and security issues.
prompt.available_hint: Validates shell scripts for safety (strict mode, credentials, background job risks)
